Basis: Patient Stretch plus nearest-lane bridge passes all numerical gates (149 counter events,38 strict pullbacks), but current BX chart has a quiet middle and a late jump. Reject by chart review. Portfolio and countertrend time exits create inventory cycles; longer Portfolio cycles restored movement but produced a 41-minute leg.
Change: Existing Portfolio accounts instead review a bounded private inventory allocation every 30-90 seconds, with independent jitter. Each review moves the existing target by 15-35% of the same funded capacity. They can add or trim existing holdings without forced zero inventory at each review. Opposite objectives close first and cool down; maximum episode 600-1200 seconds then mandatory bounded reduction. All real stops, manual protections, child caps, risk limits and IOC execution remain.
Ablation: Rolling allocations with original versus patient Stretch policy, same neighboring Maker lane. No new accounts or capital and no public/hidden future price targets.
Selection: Complete six-case development and comparable actual OHLC review. Frozen before testing. Holdouts still ungenerated and gates unchanged.
